main_argument_chains.claim: The paper turns an epidemic phase model into a facility and drug-allocation plan.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Use epidemic state, coverage, demand score, and production regime together rather than optimizing a single isolated metric.

main_argument_chains.claim: Supply capacity changes the correct allocation objective.
support_steps: Define shortage objective on infectious count.
Switch to death minimization when supply is sufficient.
Keep country infectious proportions near a fairness band.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Do not reuse shortage allocation after capacity changes; re-solve under the new regime.

warnings.warning: The multiobjective center model is normalized from OCR-damaged min/max and set notation; exact facility constraints need visual verification.
The logistic production equation uses fitted Gm/r values without a complete inventory balance.
The shortage-stage fairness constraint is visually transcribed but lacks explicit integer dose and stockout accounting.
